app.title: Brand SERP Monitor
app.subtitle: Live SERP intelligence for branded queries

scan_form.tooltip_brand: The brand slug (e.g. starcasino) — must already exist in the DB.
scan_form.tooltip_keyword: The exact query to fetch from the SERP source.
scan_form.tooltip_geo: ISO-2 country code; controls language and search engine region.
scan_form.tooltip_top_n: How many SERP positions to fetch and classify.

empty.title: No snapshots yet
empty.body: Run your first scan to populate the dashboard. Default values fetch the top 10 results for {{keyword}} in {{geo}}.

table.no_match: No domains match the current filter.

distribution.title: Category distribution
distribution.info: Share of the top-N SERP that falls into each of the four taxonomy categories. Computed by counting per-domain classifications and dividing by the snapshot's result count.

stage_breakdown.title: Pipeline stages used
stage_breakdown.info: How many of the top-N domains were resolved at each stage of the cascade. Whitelist (Stage 1) is a deterministic lookup; Algorithm (Stage 2) extracts page signals and runs rule-based classification; LLM arbiter (Stage 3) is invoked only when Stage 2 confidence falls below threshold.

sankey.title: Position lineup
sankey.info: Each tile is one SERP position (left = #1, right = #N). Tile colour = the category that domain falls into. Read at a glance whether the brand owns the top spots or is squeezed by hijackers above the fold.

trend.title: Category trend
trend.info: Daily share-of-voice for each category over the selected window. The latest snapshot of each day is used (deterministic latest-wins).
trend.empty_hint: Run scans across multiple days to draw a trend, or seed historical data with the command below.

snapshot.no_snapshots: No snapshots in the selected window.

diff.title: Compare snapshots
diff.intro: Pick two snapshots to see what changed between them — newly ranked domains, dropouts, position moves, and category changes.
diff.empty_added: Nothing entered the top-N between these snapshots.
diff.empty_moved: Every shared domain held its position and category.
diff.select_two: Select two snapshots to see the diff.

methodology.title: How classification works
methodology.intro: Each top-N SERP result is classified through a three-stage cascade. Cheaper stages run first; expensive ones only when the previous stage isn't confident.
methodology.stage1_body: Deterministic match against per-brand seed lists (official, partner, competitor) and a global informational set (news, regulators, social platforms). No I/O. Confidence 0.95.
methodology.stage2_body: Fetches the landing page, extracts signals (affiliate links, schema.org, brand vs competitor mention frequency, redirect-chain destinations), and runs rule-based classification. The decisive rule is the destination-of-redirect ratio: most redirects to the brand → partner; most to competitors → hijacker.
methodology.stage3_body: Invoked only when Stage 2 confidence falls below 0.65. A structured prompt is sent through LiteLLM (OpenRouter) with strict JSON output. Validates and clamps confidence; on any failure (network, invalid JSON, timeout) the verdict falls back to Stage 2 — the pipeline never raises.
methodology.signals_body: Affiliate-link redirect destinations · schema.org Review.itemReviewed · brand vs competitor mention frequency · primary CTA · page text sentiment · h1 / title patterns.
methodology.taxonomy_body: Four categories × sixteen subcategories. The taxonomy is frozen as code — see ``classifier/taxonomy.py``.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.empty: Activity will appear here after your first scan.

scheduler_view.title: Scheduled monitoring
scheduler_view.intro: Each row is a brand keyword scanned on a recurring cadence. Disable a row to skip it; delete to remove the schedule entirely. The scheduler must be enabled at the process level (SCHEDULER_ENABLED=true) for these jobs to fire — otherwise this is a config-only view.
scheduler_view.scheduler_off_warning: The background scheduler is currently OFF. Schedule changes are saved but jobs will not fire until SCHEDULER_ENABLED=true.
scheduler_view.empty_body: Add a keyword to monitor it on a recurring cadence.
scheduler_view.delete_confirm_body: {{keyword}} ({{geo}}) will no longer be scanned automatically. Existing snapshots are kept.

reason.whitelist_official: Domain {{domain}} is on the brand's official-domain list.
reason.whitelist_partner: Domain {{domain}} is on the brand's known-partner list.
reason.whitelist_competitor: Domain {{domain}} is on the brand's known-competitor list.
reason.whitelist_info_seed: Domain {{domain}} is on the global informational seed list (news / regulator / portal).
reason.alg_schema_review_brand: The page's schema.org Review names the brand — strong partner signal.
reason.alg_no_affiliate_info: No affiliate links on the page — treated as informational.
reason.alg_no_affiliate_news: No affiliate links and the page declares schema.org Article — treated as news.
reason.alg_brand_redirect_majority: Most affiliate redirects on the page resolve to the brand — partner site.
reason.alg_competitor_redirect_majority: Most affiliate redirects on the page resolve to competitors — hijacker site.
reason.alg_brand_mention_dominance: Mixed redirects, but the brand is mentioned more than any competitor — partner-leaning.
reason.alg_text_bait_hijacker: The brand is named in copy but every redirect goes elsewhere — text-bait hijacker.
reason.alg_fake_official_mimicry: The page claims to be the brand's official site but the domain isn't on the brand's whitelist and has no verifiable outbound links — fake-official mimicry.
reason.alg_ambiguous: Signals are ambiguous; deferring to the LLM arbiter.
reason.pipeline_fetch_failed: The page could not be fetched — falling back to informational at low confidence.
reason.pipeline_whitelist_only: Whitelist-only mode; no online classification was attempted.
reason.llm_fallback: LLM arbiter unavailable — kept the stage-2 verdict.

drilldown.no_signals: No structured signals were captured for this page.

metric.affiliate_links_desc: Outbound tracker links found on the page
metric.brand_redirect_ratio_desc: Share of affiliate redirects ending on a brand-owned domain
metric.competitor_redirect_ratio_desc: Share of affiliate redirects ending on a competitor
metric.brand_mentions_desc: Times the brand is named in the visible text
